fusions.name: Snagging Throw
fusions.desc: A barbed throw that deals 9 damage, up to 1.4 times that at maximum range, stuns the target for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Inescapable] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Draught
fusions.desc: A barbed bite that costs 5% of your maximum health, deals 8 piercing damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. You heal for 40% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Lure Call
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Caught Prey
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying one of your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
